requirements.text: The game is named "Flappy Bird Clone".
requirements.check: The game window title is 'Flappy Bird Clone'.
requirements.quote: Create a one-screen side-scrolling game called "Flappy Bird Clone".

requirements.text: A small bird stays at a fixed horizontal position near the left of the window.
requirements.check: The bird's x-coordinate remains constant and near the left edge of the screen.
requirements.quote: A small bird stays at a fixed horizontal position near the left of the window

requirements.text: The bird falls downward under constant gravity.
requirements.check: The bird's y-coordinate continuously increases unless flapped.
requirements.quote: and falls downward under constant gravity.

requirements.text: Pressing Space gives the bird an instant upward burst of velocity.
requirements.check: Pressing SPACE causes the bird's y-velocity to become negative instantly.
requirements.quote: Pressing Space gives the bird an upward flap, a single instant upward burst of velocity

requirements.text: Pipes with a gap scroll in from the right edge of the screen toward the left at a constant speed.
requirements.check: Pipes appear on the right edge and their x-coordinate decreases over time.
requirements.quote: Pipes with a gap in the middle scroll in from the right edge of the screen toward the left at a constant speed

requirements.text: A new pipe appears at a regular time interval.
requirements.check: A new pipe object is created on the right edge of the screen at consistent time intervals.
requirements.quote: with a new pipe appearing at a regular time interval

requirements.text: Each new pipe has a random gap height.
requirements.check: Successive pipes have their gaps positioned at different random y-coordinates.
requirements.quote: and a new random gap height each time.

requirements.text: Passing through a pipe's gap without touching a pipe adds 1 point.
requirements.check: When the bird's x-position passes a pipe's x-position and no collision occurs, the score increases by 1.
requirements.quote: Passing through a pipe's gap without touching a pipe adds 1 point.

requirements.text: Touching any pipe ends the game.
requirements.check: If the bird's bounding box overlaps with any part of a pipe, the game state changes to 'game over'.
requirements.quote: Touching any pipe, or the bird touching the top or bottom edge of the screen, ends the game.

requirements.text: Touching the top or bottom edge of the screen ends the game.
requirements.check: If the bird's y-position goes above 0 or below the screen height, the game state changes to 'game over'.
requirements.quote: or the bird touching the top or bottom edge of the screen, ends the game.

requirements.text: The game uses a plain sky-blue background colour.
requirements.check: The background of the game window is a solid sky-blue color.
requirements.quote: Use a plain sky-blue background colour instead of a background image.

requirements.text: The current score is shown in the top-left corner at all times.
requirements.check: A numerical score display is visible in the top-left corner of the screen and updates as points are scored.
requirements.quote: Show the current score in the top-left corner at all times.

requirements.text: When the game is over, show GAME OVER and the final score.
requirements.check: Upon game over, 'GAME OVER' text and the final score are displayed prominently on the screen.
requirements.quote: When the game is over, show GAME OVER and the final score

requirements.text: When the game is over, stop moving the pipes and the bird.
requirements.check: After game over, the bird's position and all pipe positions remain static.
requirements.quote: and stop moving the pipes and the bird.

requirements.text: Press R to restart with score 0, the bird back at its starting position, and all pipes cleared.
requirements.check: Pressing R resets the score to 0, places the bird at its initial position, and removes all pipes from the screen.
requirements.quote: Press R to restart with score 0, the bird back at its starting position, and all pipes cleared.

requirements.text: Press Escape to quit.
requirements.check: Pressing ESCAPE closes the game window.
requirements.quote: Press Escape to quit.

requirements.text: Print 'FLAP' to the console every time Space is pressed.
requirements.check: The console output contains 'FLAP' each time the Space key is pressed.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: FLAP

requirements.text: Print 'RESTART' to the console every time R is pressed.
requirements.check: The console output contains 'RESTART' each time the R key is pressed.
requirements.quote: RESTART

requirements.text: Print 'QUIT' to the console every time Escape is pressed.
requirements.check: The console output contains 'QUIT' each time the Escape key is pressed.
requirements.quote: and QUIT

requirements.text: Print 'GAME OVER' to the console when the game ends.
requirements.check: The console output contains 'GAME OVER' when the game ends.
requirements.quote: and print GAME OVER when the game ends.

requirements.text: No sounds are played.
requirements.check: No audio output is produced by the game.
requirements.quote: No sounds.

files.purpose: Marks the game directory as a Python package.
Main game logic, including initialization, game loop, event handling, and rendering.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly asks for two small image assets.

sprites.description: A small, cute, yellow bird, pixel art style, facing right, with small wings.
A green pipe segment, pixel art style, with a slightly darker green outline.

architecture.test_input_example: Press SPACE repeatedly to keep the bird aloft and navigate through pipes. If the game ends, press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.

unmapped.quote: Keep it to as few files as possible.
unmapped.handling: The Coder should consolidate game logic into a single main file (flappy_bird_clone.py) as much as possible, besides the __init__.py.
